description: Use when the user asks about what they actually paid: "why did my bill go up", "explain my bill", "are we over the estimate". Reads only; needs sign-in. For one project and one month (default: the newest with bills), compares the recorded bills with the plan's estimate for that same month, in USD, and with the month before: expected, actual and the difference over services that have both; which services make up the difference; known causes, each with the records that show it; possible explanations labelled as hypotheses, with the evidence that would settle each; and suggested actions with a savings estimate, effort and trade-off. It says plainly when the comparison is not complete: a month not over yet, bills missing for planned services, a billing connection not synced, amounts whose tax or credit scope is unknown, bills on the account but not on the project. The same charge from two sources is counted once. It never infers usage from invoice totals and never cancels, downgrades, buys or changes anything outside Kong Reviews; every action is a suggestion for the user.

compare_to.description: The earlier month to compare with, YYYY-MM. Default: the month before with bills.

currency.description: Only USD is supported; another currency is refused rather than converted.

id.description: The saved project (from get_project_context or list_saved_stacks).

month.description: The month to explain, YYYY-MM. Default: the newest with bills.

name: explain_bill

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Explain a bill against the plan
